source: sbd > 16 track 2" MR>DAT4x > Delta Dio 2496 > Soundforge > wav > Cd Wave Editor > flac > wav > flac

ai_review.summary: Fantastic performance with a smoking Sugar Magnolia > Caution transition, loose improvisational vibe, and Bob Weir’s Frozen Logger tease before El Paso; recording quality presumed solid but not detailed.
ai_review.review: The show is celebrated for its incredible Sugar Magnolia → Caution segue, a relaxed “breathing‑without‑a‑breath” feel throughout, and quirky moments like Bob Weir slipping a line from the Frozen Logger into El Paso. Pigpen’s song choices also receive high praise. Reviewers give no concrete audio comments, implying the recording is at least listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are 5‑star and uniformly enthusiastic about musical performance; no major recording complaints, so a high combined rating is justified.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers do not mention soundboard or audience issues; audio presumed satisfactory based on overall praise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth and loose, highlighted by an amazing Sugar Magnolia‑Caution transition and a relaxed, breathing‑like feel that carries through the set.

band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for rocking out with Bill during the transition.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for slipping a verse of the Frozen Logger before El Paso.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s sweet song choices are highlighted positively.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill is praised for his energetic contribution alongside Phil.
